neighbours.label: ' to be' after a reporting passive that hedges a claim (is believed to be, is thought to be)
fire: The total cost is believed to be over ten million.
The old bridge is thought to be the first in the region.
The final toll is estimated to be in the hundreds.
Her fortune is said to be enormous by local standards.
The lost city is believed to be under the lake.
The painting is thought to be a copy of the original.
The tree is estimated to be two thousand years old.
The author is believed to be a monk from Ireland.
quiet: The total cost was over ten million by May.
The old bridge stands as the first in the region.
The final toll was published in the hundreds.
Her fortune came from a shop in the town.
The lost city lies under the lake near here.
The painting hangs next to a copy of the original.
The tree grows two meters a year in spring.
The author worked as a monk in Ireland.

notes: Card: ' have' x5, ' estimated' x4, ' that' x3, ' origin' x2, '.' x2, ' think' x2, broadly about uncertain claims. Probes: ' be' in 'believed to be' 0.391, ' have' 0.149, ' in' 0.136, ' at' 0.082, '.' 0.122. A guess at the strongest; median may be weak.
